corrections.bug: Research disclaimer validator required the literal substring 'not a treatment recommendation'.
corrections.effect: Grammatically valid shared-negation statements such as 'not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation' were incorrectly rejected.
corrections.correction: Accept explicit semantically equivalent negated diagnosis-and-treatment disclaimer constructions.

corrections.bug: Numerical validator required the expected lesion-pixel value to appear exactly once.
corrections.effect: A repeated but unchanged evidence value was incorrectly classified as a numerical-copy error.
corrections.correction: Require at least one exact expected value and require every numerical token to equal that same protected value.
